'''Nield's cousin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. She was left to take care of her younger cousin [[Nield]] at age fourteen when Nield's [[Parent/Legends|mother]],<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> [[Leidra]],<ref name="The Uncertain Path">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref> went off to fight in a battle against the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Death/Legends|died]]. Nield and his cousin escaped to the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]] during a later Melida invasion, where they stayed for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. When she was seventeen years old and Nield was eight, she was forced to fight in a Daan attack on the Melida sector, in which she perished.<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />
